summary: Read two integers n and k. n is from 1 to 105, and k is from n to 26 times n. A lowercase letter scores its place in the alphabet, so a scores 1, b scores 2, and so on until z scores 26. A lowercase string scores the sum of its letters. Write the string that has length exactly n, scores exactly k, and is the smallest such string in dictionary order.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
